arStrings.szText: "Tell me, why did you murder that person?"
Those like us have but one rule, never succumb to the demands of another. Demons are ours to command...right, Warlock?
It’s no mistake you witnessed this fool’s demise. I sought you out because I desire a student in the black arts. But so few are worthy of my gifts.
If you would be my disciple, seek out my sanctum and I will unveil much more. Come, Valloch, let us be on our way.
